Field/Scenario: accountNumber shown masked at all permission levels except owner's own form
Preconditions: Family sharing enabled for this user's data
Test Steps: 1. Share net worth view with a family member at Contacts Only / View Only access. 2. Family member views the savings account entry.
Expected Result: Family member sees maskedNumber (••••7890) and familyMemberTag, never the full accountNumber; only the owner viewing/editing the form itself sees the unmasked number.

Field/Scenario: listColumns render correctly in list view
Preconditions: At least one savings account record exists
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Savings Accounts list view. 2. Inspect displayed columns.
Expected Result: List view displays exactly: bankName, accountType, maskedNumber, familyMemberTag, currentBalance, currency columns with correct values for each row.

Field/Scenario: Deleting a savings account updates net worth aggregation
Preconditions: A savings account with currentBalance=150000 INR exists and is included in net worth
Test Steps: 1. Note total net worth / CASH bucket total. 2. Delete the savings account record. 3. Recheck net worth / CASH bucket total.
Expected Result: Net worth and CASH allocation bucket totals decrease by the deleted account's converted value; no stale reference remains in aggregation.

Field/Scenario: Currency conversion for USD account into base currency
Preconditions: User's base currency is INR; a savings account with currency=USD exists
Test Steps: 1. Create/view a savings account with currency=USD and currentBalance=1000. 2. View net worth totals in base currency (INR).
Expected Result: Value function convert(currentBalance, currency, user) correctly converts USD balance to INR equivalent using the applicable exchange rate before adding to CASH allocation and net worth totals.
